deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.51.0 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

Repo targets Python 3.12/3.13 (requires-python >=3.12, CI matrix 3.12/3.13). 3.14 is pending upstream verification: openhands-sdk support for 3.14 is unconfirmed. Re-evaluate when the SDK's supported range covers 3.14.

deferrals.name: OSS_CAD_SUITE_RELEASE
deferrals.reason: The pinned suite tarball vendors python2.7/python3.11 site-packages carrying 6 upstream-borne CVEs (9 Trivy findings) that no in-repo change can fix; they are waived in .trivyignore until 2027-01-03. On the next OSS_CAD_SUITE_RELEASE bump, re-scan the image and drop the waivers that upstream's rebuilt pythons cleared.
